about: A tiny kit release and its content_sha256, as kit/scripts/plugin-release.py content_sha computes it (one SHA-256 over each file's path relative to the release, NUL, 'x' if executable else '-', NUL, its bytes, NUL; files of a folder before its subfolders, each sorted by name; __pycache__ folders, .pyc files and .talos-release left out). Root's kit.py (talos-wsl kit-update) and the supervisor's releaseContentSha (apps/bridge/src/supervisor/worker-hook.ts) are both held to it. Computed by the real plugin-release.py, run as the files' owner. A file's mode is `mode` (octal) when given, else 0755 if `exec`, else 0644: the x flag is "can the reader execute it", so root's kit-update copies every file 0555 or 0444 and nothing in between. Names are sorted by code point (Python's sorted(), the same as UTF-8 byte order), never UTF-16 units.

files.text: after b? no: a folder's own files come before its subfolders
U+FFFD: before U+1F600 by code point, after it by UTF-16 unit
owner may run it; the caller is the owner here
